notes: Plans only. Joshi's Fig. 4 is titled a sketch plan and its walls are not drawn square: the south rampart segments give -12.9 and -15.2 degrees, the west wall -9.2 and the cross wall -16.1. Lines were grouped by wall, so the main system is the south rampart and the west and cross walls are single-line systems that fail the neighbour condition. Only walls drawn black ('exposed rubble structure') were measured; the hatched walls marked 'conjecture' were not. The scale bars of the two plans imply different site sizes (about 185 m and about 123 m end to end); lengths only weight lines within a source. The chapter's Fig. 3.2 draws the walls nearly square to the page with its arrow 10.8 degrees clockwise of vertical; its five wall edges give -10.4 to -14.1 degrees, and all its hatched-band fits use under half of their profiles because of the hatching, as the overlay check shows.
